content.title: CTOS Q3 Deep Dive: Utility Sector and Rental Fleet Investments Shape Outlook
content.summary: Heavy equipment distributor Custom Truck One Source (NYSE:CTOS) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 7.8% year on year to $482.1 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $2.02 billion at the midpoint. Its GAAP loss of $0.03 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
